changeSet.author: nexus-ztafa
changeSet.comment: Re-files nexus.catalog_collections rows hygiene-002-1's branch D misclassified solely because their owner segment carries an underscore, which that changeset's owner grammar ([a-zA-Z0-9-]+) rejects but the client/test-helper grammar ([a-zA-Z0-9-]+(?:_[a-zA-Z0-9-]+)*, a single underscore between two alnum/hyphen tokens, never a bare "__") admits. Candidate selection is branch D's own exclusive signature (content_type = 'unknown' AND owner_id = tenant_id AND lifecycle_state = 'disputed'); re-classification copies hygiene-002-1's branch A/B/C rules verbatim, restricted to that candidate set only.
